html:
What is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in October, is a question of interest to many tourists, especially those who are planning to travel to Ninh Binh and this is also the first time you set foot in Ninh Binh, so to know that, let’s refer to the Ninh Binh travel experience in October that Vietlook Trave will share with you right through this article.

Ninh Binh in October is entering the transitional season, the weather is gradually turning to winter and there are cool breezes, the clear blue sky is very convenient for tourists to visit and sightsee.

Should you travel to Ninh Binh in October?

Ninh Binh in October often brings its own beauty, a peaceful and quiet space, rich natural scenery as if to urge travelers to come to Ninh Binh, surrounded by majestic limestone ranges, and immense river scenery, creating a unique beauty.

Ninh Binh climate in October

Usually fluctuates from 22 – 26 degrees Celsius, and there is no rain, so it is very convenient for tourists to check in and take virtual photos in Ninh Binh. At the scenic spots, the weather is quite beautiful, very suitable for tourists to visit and sightsee. However, in October, Ninh Binh has a bit of a chilly weather, so you should bring a long-sleeved shirt to avoid getting cold.

Where to stay when traveling to Ninh Binh in October is a question for tourists traveling to Ninh Binh for the first time. However, according to Vietlook’s Ninh Binh travel experience, Ninh Binh has many places to stay from budget to high-end, but it all depends on your budget.

Places to visit in Binh Binh in October

Bai Dinh Pagoda

If you are looking for places to visit in Ninh Binh in October, Bai Dinh Pagoda is an indispensable destination in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary in October. The pagoda has a large campus and is a massive spiritual complex with its own architectural style. Every year in October, the pagoda becomes peaceful and solemn, attracting tourists from all over the world to come here to worship.

Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

A famous destination with 1000 years of history located in the 4 World Heritage complexes of Ninh Binh, Hoa Lu Ancient Capital has an ancient architectural style. Although it has gone through many years, Hoa Lu Ancient Capital still retains its own beauty.

Hang Mua

No matter what season you come to Ninh Binh, Hang Mua is an indispensable destination when you have the opportunity to visit here. When conquering the mountain top, visitors can see the full beauty of Ninh Binh from above, especially when conquering 500 stone steps, visitors can freely take beautiful pictures.

Trang An

A destination chosen by many tourists, when traveling to Trang An in October, you should experience rowing a boat on the lake to admire the poetic beauty, the lake is as calm as a sheet of paper, a peaceful scene enough for you to save beautiful pictures.

Am Tien Cave

This is one of the naturally formed caves surrounded by towering limestone mountains, with a clear blue lake in the middle. It is a relaxing spot chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to visit Ninh Binh, especially those who travel to Ninh Binh in October.

To reach Am Tien Cave, visitors should go through the tunnel through the mountain, and climb up the cave to burn incense and admire the magical stalactites.

Van Long Lagoon

To fully experience the beauty of the lagoon, take a boat on the lagoon. When the boat glides gently, you will also admire the poetic scenery. In addition, there are many rare animals here, including the white-cheeked langur, which is listed in the Red Book….

Thung Nham Bird Garden

In October, visitors come to the bird garden with many birds flying back to winter, visitors can record the most beautiful moments, especially at dusk when flocks fly away to find food, which is very beautiful and makes many visitors feel excited.

At this point, you must have your own answer such as what is beautiful when traveling to Ninh Binh in October, and where to visit, where to stay, so come to Ninh Binh once in October to feel all the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.
